AurielIncreasingClaritySacredSweepTalent.name: Increasing Clarity
AurielIncreasingClaritySacredSweepTalent.description: Quest: Every time Sacred Sweep hits a Hero in the center, increase the center damage by 2, up to 50. Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, this center damage bonus is increased to 180.

AurielRighteousAssaultSacredSweepTalent.name: Righteous Assault
AurielRighteousAssaultSacredSweepTalent.description: Reduces the cooldown of Sacred Sweep by 3 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by its center.

AurielSearingLightRayOfHeavenTalent.name: Searing Light
AurielSearingLightRayOfHeavenTalent.description: Ray of Heaven also deals damage to enemies in the area equal to 30% of the energy consumed.

AurielMajesticSpanSacredSweepTalent.name: Majestic Span
AurielMajesticSpanSacredSweepTalent.description: Increases the radius of Sacred Sweep by 15%.

AurielHeavyBurdenDetainmentStrikeTalent.name: Heavy Burden
AurielHeavyBurdenDetainmentStrikeTalent.description: Detainment Strike Slows enemy Heroes by 20% for 2.5 seconds. Slow amount and duration doubled on enemies it Stuns. Passive: Increase Detainment Strikes' Stun duration by 0.25 seconds.

AurielRepeatedOffenseDetainmentStrikeTal.name: Repeated Offense
AurielRepeatedOffenseDetainmentStrikeTal.description: Enemies hit by Detainment Strike are knocked back 25% farther. Quest: Every time Detainment Strike stuns a Hero, increase the stun damage by 10, up to 60. Reward: After stunning 6 Heroes, increase this damage bonus to 250.

AurielGlimmerofHopeRayOfHeavenTalent.name: Glimmer of Hope
AurielGlimmerofHopeRayOfHeavenTalent.description: Collecting a Regeneration Globe reduces the cost of Auriel's next Ray of Heaven by 75%.

AurielEmpathicLinkBestowHopeTalent.name: Empathic Link
AurielEmpathicLinkBestowHopeTalent.description: Auriel stores 25% of damage taken by allies with Bestow Hope.

AurielEnergizedCordRayOfHeavenTalent.name: Energized Cord
AurielEnergizedCordRayOfHeavenTalent.description: Increases the energy stored from Auriel's Basic Attacks to 120% of the damage against Heroes and 55% of the damage against non-Heroes. Does not affect Auriel's Bestow Hope ally.

AurielHeroicResurrect.name: Resurrect
AurielHeroicResurrect.description: Channel on the spirit of a dead ally for 1 second. After a 5 second delay, they are brought back to life with 100% of their maximum Health at the location where they died. Auriel can use this ability while dead to resurrect herself.

AurielHeroicCrystalAegis.name: Crystal Aegis
AurielHeroicCrystalAegis.description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.

AurielBlindingFlashSacredSweepTalent.name: Blinding Flash
AurielBlindingFlashSacredSweepTalent.description: Enemies hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep are blinded for 2 seconds.

AurielConvergingForceSacredSweepTalent.name: Converging Force
AurielConvergingForceSacredSweepTalent.description: Enemies hit by the outer area are pushed slightly toward the center.

AurielPiercingLashDetainmentStrikeTalent.name: Piercing Lash
AurielPiercingLashDetainmentStrikeTalent.description: Detainment Strike now pierces and hits all enemy Heroes in a line, reducing the cooldown by 2 seconds for each Hero hit.

AurielReservoirofHopeRayOfHeavenTalent.name: Reservoir of Hope
AurielReservoirofHopeRayOfHeavenTalent.description: Quest: Each maximum energy Ray of Heaven Auriel casts increases the maximum amount of energy that can be stored by 75.

AurielWillofHeavenBestowHopeTalent.name: Will of Heaven
AurielWillofHeavenBestowHopeTalent.description: Allies with Bestow Hope gain 20% Attack Speed. Passive: Auriel gains 10% increased Basic Attack Damage.

AurielWrathofHeavenBestowHopeTalent.name: Wrath of Heaven
AurielWrathofHeavenBestowHopeTalent.description: Allies with Bestow Hope gain 10% Spell Power. Enemy Heroes hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep or the terrain collision of Detainment Strike have their Spell Armor reduced by 10 for 3 seconds.

AurielLightSpeedResurrectTalent.name: Light Speed
AurielLightSpeedResurrectTalent.description: Resurrected allies gain 200% increased Movement Speed, decaying over 4 seconds. While a resurrected ally remains alive, Resurrect's next cooldown recharges 100% faster.

AurielDiamondResolveCrystalAegisTalent.name: Diamond Resolve
AurielDiamondResolveCrystalAegisTalent.description: When Crystal Aegis expires, it grants the target 75 Armor for 5 seconds, reducing damage taken by 75%.

AurielAngelicFlightTalent.name: Angelic Flight
AurielAngelicFlightTalent.description: After 2 seconds, fly to a target location.

AurielShieldOfHopeTalent.name: Shield of Hope
AurielShieldOfHopeTalent.description: Activate to grant all nearby allied Heroes a shield for 3 seconds equal to 50% of the amount of Health they are missing.
